{SHOUT:crazydave}WOOOO! TEAM PLANTS!!! TEAM PLANTS!!!
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, did you not listen to what I said 3 days ago?
{SAY:winnie}These football-loving, soccer-loving, whatever-loving zombies are immune to hypnosis.
{TIRED:crazydave}Oh.
{SAY:zombossicon}You truly are an imbecile!
{SAY:zombossicon}Consider these plants endangered! We will take these useless shrooms as our trophy!
{SAY:zombossicon}Go, Team Zombies!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_SPORTZBALL_7_INTRO: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. My scans show that a high volume of skilled All-Star Zombies are approaching.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Well, it doesn't matter anyway. GO TEAM PLANTS!!! WOOOO!!!
{SAY:winnie}Unfortunately, our seed packet reserves suddenly ran low on resources overnight.
{SAY:winnie}Some plants have zero stock at the moment. Someone must have been behind it.
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Precisely! That invisibility ray has done me wonders!
{SAY:zombossicon}Let's see how your pathetic Team Plants can fend against these hotshots!
{EXCITED:crazydave}That's a foul, Boss Man! BOOOOOOO! Give this guy a red card!
{SAY:zombossicon}Oh, go cry about it, David! Team Zombies shall prevail!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_SPORTZBALL_10_INTR: {EXCITED:crazydave}9 victories and one more and Team Plants will get the sweep!
{SAY:winnie}I admire your enthusiasm for this sport, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}But we have to stand our ground today. Zomboss is preparing the remaining players for one final round.
{SAY:zombossicon}This whole back and forth has gotten me bored of this entire sport!
{SAY:zombossicon}Next time you want to crash a passtime of mine, at least be polite about it!
{SAY:zombossicon}Bah, this is useless! I should be spending my free time more wisely anyways.
{SAY:zombossicon}I have to prepare for something... special for next time.
{SAY:zombossicon}In the meantime, do whatever you want with these remaining football players.
{SAY:zombossicon}Silence, David! Stay invested in this pointless sport as much as you'd like.
{SAY:zombossicon}Meanwhile, I will stay true to my passion!
{SAY:zombossicon}Soon enough, I will cloud your festivities with darkness! Enjoy the game while you still can!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_1_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, it's time! It's the most wonderful time of the year!
{EXCITED:winnie}And this time it is not Zomboss's doing. Happy holidays, User Dave.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Thanks, Penny! Do you think Santa will come visit us this year?
{SAY:winnie}I have no concrete information that backs up the existence of this "Santa Claus."
{TIRED:crazydave}Why do you have to be so cold, Penny?
{SAY:crazydave}Besides, I know he's real. He has an entire legion of followers.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Hint: They don't like it when you try to expose them around shopping malls.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I wonder what the zombies are gonna do about that.
{SAY:winnie}Statistically, they will just strive for our brains as per usual.
{SAY:winnie}Though, this time of year makes zombies jolly enough to resist chilling effects. Be wary.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_3_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Hey, wait a minute. What are those other zombies doing here?
{SAY:crazydave}Don't tell me they're gonna give me furnaces and jetpacks as presents!
{SAY:winnie}It seems zombies from other time eras are coming in to join the festivities.
{SAY:winnie}As well as a group of Pianists dressing up and changing their tune for the occasion.
{SAY:crazydave}Oooh! They might want to redeem themselves and try getting into Santa's nice list!
{SAY:winnie}This is when the holidays truly begin, User Dave. Get ready for more surprise attacks.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_4_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Brrr... Neighbor, what are we doing this late at night?
{EXCITED:crazydave}My pot isn't enough to withstand the cold!
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Zombies, User Dave. They are yearning for your brains even at nighttime.
{TIRED:crazydave}Oh bummer. Thought I could get some shut-eye after trying to catch that mall Santa all day...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_8_INTRO_: {SAY:zombossicon}I hope you both are having a wonderful Feastivus today.
{SAY:zombossicon}Because I am here to spoil your mood!
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}What are you talking about, Boss Man? You finally get the vacation you've always wanted!
{SAY:crazydave}Don't you want to hang out with your zombie buds?
{SAY:zombossicon}Shut up, David! You just don't get it!
{SAY:zombossicon}I wanted a vacation that I earned, not a vacation I waited for!
{SAY:zombossicon}And since you three have been pestering me non-stop all year...
{SAY:zombossicon}I will be more than glad to ruin this so called "most wonderful time of the year" for you.
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{TIRED:crazydave}Guess Boss Man is staying in Santa's naughty list...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_9_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}Just in time for the holidays, the Holly Barrier has arrived. They launch their berries to a place of your choice.
{SAY:winnie}Upon landing, the berries do light knockback, and proceed to act as a wall that damages zombies near it.
{SAY:winnie}But fire wisely, as they have limited ammo. The ammo can only be refilled by using Plant Food or Intensive Carrot.
{SAY:winnie}Intensive Carrot will only work on Holly Barrier itself.
{SAY:winnie}Using it on its leaves will result in nothing, wasting the Intensive Carrot.
{NPC_EXIT:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}How come zombies can eat these just fine...
{EXCITED:crazydave}But when I do it I'm "in danger" and "need to go to the hospital!"
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_12_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}You DARE have fun with the holiday spirit after ruining MY fun!?
{SAY:zombossicon}You enjoy all the holiday cheer yet have allowed me none in the past!
{SAY:zombossicon}And don't lie to me, I know!
{SAY:zombossicon}I have been watching you fight off my zombies, and it DOES look like you are having jolly fun!
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Have you just been watching us the whole time, Boss Man?
{SAY:zombossicon}Yes! Well... not like, the whole time...
{SAY:zombossicon}I have hobbies during the holidays too!
{SAY:zombossicon}I certainly have a party to attend to! As well as tons and tons of guests!
{SAY:zombossicon}Including my beloved family who very much enjoy my presence!
{SAY:crazydave}Oh... Well, I'm not hearing any background music or anything.
{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Zomboss, didn't you send out one of your family members for a fight?
{SAY:winnie}And my scanners show no signs of a party or cheery atmosphere transferring over the signal.
{SAY:zombossicon}...(static that suspiciously sounds like blowing into a microphone)...
{SAY:zombossicon}Oh noooooo! The signal is cutting off, I can't hear yoooou!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_15_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, do you think we've made it on the nice list this year?
{SAY:winnie}Disregarding the legitimacy of this so called "Santa Claus", we have put a stop to many zombie invasions.
{EXCITED:winnie}I believe we are more than qualified for those positions.
{SAY:crazydave}I guess that means Mr. Boss Man's totally on the naughty list, right?
{SAY:crazydave}Wouldn't you wanna be on the nice list? Think of all the cool presents!
{SAY:zombossicon}Bah! How cliche. I have a much more brilliant course of action, as you would expect from me.
{SAY:zombossicon}That holly jolly fatso's been giving me nothing but coal every year!
{SAY:zombossicon}I have got a literal truckload of this stuff, so I have arranged a shipment of it all onto your premises.
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{EXCITED:crazydave}My nightmare of coal raining from the sky is coming true!!!
{SAY:winnie}To reassure you, these coal shipments are coming from an incoming snowstorm.
{SAY:winnie}Intensive Carrot shall assist us with this sudden coal barrage.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_18_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I would like to share some bad news.
{SAY:crazydave}What is it Penny? Has the revoution against the head Santa begun?
{SAY:winnie}Our seed packet supply on offensive plants has gone extremely low.
{SAY:winnie}And it will be a while before we can stabilize our supply, too.
{SAY:crazydave}Oh, then you could just send those fellas through a special delivery!
{TIRED:winnie}Specifically because somebody clogged the conveyor belt through excessive snowball fighting.
{EXCITED:crazydave}HEY! I had to take those fake Santas down!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Their fake beards came flying off! It was glorious!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Once my mission is over, I shall become the new head Santa!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_23_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}You cretins truly are difficult to extinguish.
{SAY:zombossicon}Day and night, you and your shoddy, pestilent shrubs still come out on top!
{SAY:zombossicon}I am tired of losing to these puny, organic weeds!
{SAY:zombossicon}I will make sure I deserve to be on the naughty list, you hear me David?!
{SAY:zombossicon}Tonight, I will begin plotting for a spectacular Feastivus present, just for you!
{SAY:zombossicon}And I am sure you all will have your jaws dropping... in fear!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Huh, what? I just finished sipping on some hot chocolate.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_24_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}As expected, you are all still kicking.
{SAY:zombossicon}You three are loud, aggravating, and utterly annoying with your holiday cheer!
{SAY:zombossicon}Given the choice between the three of you, I'd take a seasick crocodile!
{SAY:winnie}Zomboss, your hatred of User Dave and his neighbor has reached levels of mean-ness unquantifiable.
{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Oh, you so deserve to go on the naughty list!
{SAY:crazydave}You're mean Mr. Boss Man! You really don't know how to feel!
{SAY:crazydave}You're mean towards Cactus and you're as slippery as a banana peel, Mr. Boss Man!
{SAY:zombossicon}Rhymes have no correlation to reason! Although I am flattered.
{SAY:winnie}That information was, in fact, factually correct. You are acting terribly.
{SAY:zombossicon}Oh, I don't wanna hear it, time traveling domicile!
{SAY:zombossicon}Remnants of the Holiday Mashup initiative may have some use tonight...
{SAY:zombossicon}This is one last warning before I completely cook up what's coming at your territory tomorrow.
{SAY:zombossicon}Your holiday joy shall wimper and die, for I ain't the king of sinful sots!!
{SAY:zombossicon}Any last Feastivus wishes?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}How about another taco with a waffle in it?
{EXCITED:crazydave}Mmm... I can still feel the aftertaste.
{SAY:zombossicon}Disgusting! That was ages ago, David!
{SAY:zombossicon}Bah! I shall take my leave!
{SAY:zombossicon}Watch as various holidays return and remind you of how many of them you have assaulted!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnie}Warning, User Dave. I detect a massive amount of zombies approaching tonight. This shall not be easy.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2023_12_FEASTIVUS_25_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}That's it! I have had it with you three!
{SAY:zombossicon}This year has been filled with nothing but a bunch of nuisances!
{SAY:zombossicon}I am starting to reconsider even going for your brains again after that fight on the roof!
{SAY:zombossicon}But now, I am no longer holding back!
{SAY:zombossicon}You wanted to eat something scrumptious, right, David?
{SAY:zombossicon}Now go and gobble this one up! Because you are all in for a treat!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, are you detecting a huge taco nearby or what?
{EXCITED:crazydave}How about a robotic version of the main Santa Claus? That'd be so cool.
{SAY:crazydave}A cake? I've already eaten so much candy, I think I'll be sick!
{SAY:winnie}Even so, I detect high levels of untrustworthiness on the aforementioned cake.
{SAY:winnie}Rest assured, this delicacy may be another one of Zomboss's awful ideas.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny, what are we doing back here?!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_2: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I already got my taco a while ago, best I can do here now is dip my feet in the nearby quicksand!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_3: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}You should try it out sometime, Penny!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}I am incapable of performing feet-related activities, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}We've revisited this location due to the concerning spike of temporal tremors recently.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}From what my scanners can gather, they aren't just occuring here but in other time periods we've visited as well.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}The mythological creatures known as "gnomes" do not actually exist. They come from folklore.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_10: {SAY:crazydave}Maybe you're right. What could it be then?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_1_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}I'll scan the immediate perimeter. In the meantime, please fend off the incoming zombie horde.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{SAY:crazydave}Now we're back here? Gee, I missed the smell of seawater and pirate sweat...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_2: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, my sensors have cracked down on what has been going on.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:crazydave}I just got a message on my phone saying that I won the jackpot prize in a raffle!!!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:crazydave}They're instructing me to send over your encryption key to redeem it!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, you have never particpated in any raffles, have you?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Then please do not even entertain the idea of responding to that message.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}Even if you have, it sounds extremely suspicious.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}Anyways, my scans have picked up some other interesting results.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}ZCorp Incorporated, the zombie-based company that Zomboss has cooperated with in the past...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_13: {SAY:winnie}And they seem to recently have started "invading" various points in time to advertise a new product.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}Right now, they've set their sights on the Pirate Seas.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}It is possible they'll aim for the rest of the eras we've previously visited.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_16: {SAY:winnie}If this keeps on going, it could lead to another destabilization of space and time.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_2_INTRO_18: {SAY:winnie}Approximately. We must continuously track them down and ensure they don't perform anything dangerous.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_5_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Penny! My computer has been going coo-coo crazy recently!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_5_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}There's only room for one lunatic here!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_5_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, can you elaborate on what exactly you've been clicking before this happened?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_5_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:crazydave}One of them even showed how fast it can make my gourd grow in just a few days!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_5_INTRO_9: {TIRED:winnie}My disappointment value is reaching 5 digit integers.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_5_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}User Dave, we are facing against corporate agents here, and they're likely skilled in scamming as well.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_5_INTRO_11: {SAY:winnie}Your desktop device may be extremely unsecure. I recommend not using it for the time being.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_5_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}Furthermore, is my encryption key stored in there?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_5_INTRO_15: {SAY:crazydave}Eh, don't worry about it. I'll just ask this "ad blocker" guy to help me out with it.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_5_INTRO_16: {EXCITED:crazydave}The internet told me they're really reliable for stuff like this, so let me call them in a bit!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_5_INTRO_17: {EXCITED:winnie}90% OFF ON ALL PRODUCTS! SHOP NOW!!!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Have you ever wondered how to deal with your crowded lawn?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}Well look no further, as the HelpDesk Task Force is here to save the day!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_4: {EXCITED:winnie}Need a few weeds burnt beyond recognition? HelpDesks will get it done in no time!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:winnie}HelpDesk Task Force! For hire for the low-low affordable price of 5600 Zombucks!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:winnie}Call now to get an 80% discount on your latest hire of the task force!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:winnie}Just make sure to send the numbers behind your credit card and we'll be doing business!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}ZCorp Incorporated is not responsible for any damages dealt to any bystanders, property or other individuals.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_11: {EXCITED:crazydave}That's a great idea, Penny! I'll call them now!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_7_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:crazydave}The ad blocker guy will have to wait!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_12_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{TIRED:crazydave}Neighbor, it seems it's just the two of us again.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_12_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Penny got taken over by the ZCorp fellas!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_12_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:crazydave}Those darn HelpDesks pulled a fast one on me!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_12_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}You fight off the zombies, and I'll try to save Penny!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}I'm getting all dizzy from all the time-jumping we've been doing!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:winnie}No worries, for ZCure is here to save the day!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:winnie}Not only does it cure nausea, but virtually any disease as well!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:winnie}"Zombieism" is not recognized in the ZCorp catalogue as a legitimate illness!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_10: {EXCITED:crazydave}And why not? It spreads like crazy!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:winnie}Because we're not zombies! Thus we do not need it! And neither do you!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_13: {EXCITED:crazydave}But me and my neighbor ARE humans!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_20: {EXCITED:winnie}You're not getting rid of us that easily, bucko!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_21: {EXCITED:winnie}You know too much! And so does your buddy!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_22: {EXCITED:winnie}We have a special procedure for situations like this!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_13_INTRO_25: {EXCITED:crazydave}Almost there, we're gonna save Penny in no time!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}We've provoked ZCorp into launching a FULL-OUT attack!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_3: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:crazydave}Come on ZCorp, show us your worst!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_5: {EXCITED:winnie}Our lawyers are too cut-throat for you!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_6: {EXCITED:winnie}We have already sent you a physical cease-and-desist order.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:winnie}Prepare to face off our newest improved product in combat!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_8: {EXCITED:winnie}After multiple battles, multiple defeats in the warzone...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_9: {EXCITED:winnie}Our beloved hero has gone through various tribulations at the hands of the crooked plants!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_10: {EXCITED:winnie}But now, he's back, stronger than ever!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_12: {EXCITED:winnie}With advanced technological advancements, he is ready to step into the battlefield once more!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_13: {TIRED:winnie}Enhanced by the genius minds over at ZCorp Incorporated- *bzzt* -and the GREAT Dr. Edgar Zomboss! *bzzt*
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_14: {EXCITED:winnie}You can get a destructive machine now for just 12000 Zombucks for your first purchase!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_16: {TIRED:winnie}This program is rated T for all ages. Viewer disrection-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_17: {NPC_EXIT:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Z-Mech is coming for another round of revenge.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_18: {EXCITED:crazydave}After defeating this clown we'll be able to save Penny!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_19: {EXCITED:crazydave}Once we bust it up, their advertising will no longer be profitable!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_01_ZCORP_15_INTRO_20: {EXCITED:crazydave}And I'll use the chance to reboot Penny and rid her of their influence!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_02_LUNARZOOYEAR_1_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Woo boy, look at all those fireworks go!
{SAY:crazydave}But wait... I'm confused, didn't the new year happen a month ago already?
{SAY:winnie}However, Chinese culture utilizes a different calendarian system from the Western world.
{SAY:winnie}Hence why they celebrate the arrival of the new year a bit later than the majority.
{SAY:crazydave}Hold on, does that mean the zombies are Chinese? Why are they celebrating this?

NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_05_BIRTHDAYZ_9_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I've done further investigations towards our current situation.

NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_05_BIRTHDAYZ_11_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Yes, very good, machine. You've finally figured out what's actually going on!

NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_1_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Hey Penny, do we have anything planned for this year's summer celebrations?
{SAY:winnie}Plans have not been made as of yet, User Dave. What do you have in mind?
{EXCITED:crazydave}With all the fireworks, music, and expired fruit juice we can get our hands on!
{SAY:winnie}Arrangements can be made accordingly, User Dave.
{SAY:crazydave}I'll handle the guest list! You can prepare the fireworks and everything else.
{TIRED:winnie}In other words, you want me to do all the work?
{EXCITED:crazydave}You're not doing all the work! I'm handling the guest list, remember?
{SAY:winnie}Very well. In preparation for the party however, it seems that we need to do some preliminary house cleaning.
{SAY:winnie}I'm already preoccupied with other tasks, User Dave.
{SAY:crazydave}In that case, can you clean up these zombies for me, neighbor?
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Don't worry, I'll make sure to put you in the VIP list right after you're finished!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_2_INT: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Pardon me for our sudden relocation. I assure you that there is an explanation for this.
{SAY:winnie}User Dave has requested there to be fresh coconut water for our party's refreshments.
{SAY:winnie}This beach is the most suitable location I can think of to gather such resources.
{SAY:winnie}I don't think this will be a simple one time endeavour.
{SAY:winnie}We may need to return to this beach over the course of our party preparations.
{SAY:winnie}Hopefully User Dave is doing his part to take care of the zombies back at home.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_3_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave. Why do I keep seeing zombies appearing in our front lawn?
{SAY:winnie}Need I remind you that the party is scheduled to be a week from now?
{SAY:winnie}We'll need the house to be clean in that amount of time.
{TIRED:winnie}User Dave. Is there something you're not telling me?
{TIRED:crazydave}I might have invited some of them by mistake.
{SAY:winnie}How do you accidentally invite zombies to your party?
{SAY:crazydave}Look, Penny. When you're as much of a party-goer as I am...
{SAY:crazydave}You'd have gone through thousands of these parties.
{SAY:crazydave}Some that may or may not have zombies in them.
{SAY:crazydave}It becomes a blur past a certain point.
{SAY:crazydave}Sometimes you wanna keep in touch after a wild night of partying, y'know?
{SAY:winnie}I cannot even think of a scenario unfolding, but I find arguing the feasability of such events to be moot.
{SAY:winnie}I am enacting a strict no-zombie rule on the guest list, User Dave.
{SAY:winnie}You're going to have to tell these guys to go.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_4_INT: {SAY:winnie}Again, this is done under User Dave's requests.
{SAY:winnie}He is of the opinion that the party would be livelier with even more beverages.
{SAY:winnie}Unluckily for us, his requested brand of beverage is one recalled in the early 1990s.
{SAY:winnie}This time period is the only place we'll be able to retrieve it from.
{SAY:winnie}Look alive! Some zombies might not take kindly to us taking these precious resources away.
{TIRED:winnie}Pardon the sarcasm. These preparations are proven to be tiring.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_5_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{TIRED:winnie}User Dave, why are there still zombies on the lawn?
{TIRED:winnie}I thought I told you to rid of them when I went out to buy those colas.
{SAY:winnie}Then why do I see invitation cards in the possession of the zombies we're cleaning out?
{EXCITED:crazydave}I have no idea! I already turned zombies that I invited away yesterday!
{SAY:winnie}I'll put aside some time to investigate after I'm done handling the fireworks shipment.
{SAY:winnie}In the meantime, I entrust you with bouncer duty.
{SAY:winnie}Hopefully this should be the last of them.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_8_INT: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Look, Penny, I know what you're thinking, but I swear, it's not me.
{SAY:winnie}Then who can it be? Someone is inviting all these zombies to our party.
{SAY:winnie}I'm not doing it, neither is your neighbor. So who could it-
{SAY:zombossicon}This is not what it looks like!
{SAY:crazydave}Are you tricking your zombies into thinking they were invited to our party, Boss Man?
{SAY:zombossicon}I assure you that there's a perfectly good explanation for this.
{SAY:winnie}And what would that perfectly good explanation be?
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{TIRED:winnie}I cannot rationally comprehend what just happened.
{SAY:winnie}Regardless of that perplexing encounter, there are more zombies that need taken care of.
{SAY:winnie}These Missile Toes I hired as performers...
{SAY:winnie}...they have a very strict policy of not performing with zombies around.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Drats! We can't lose the main act!
{EXCITED:crazydave}Neighbor! It's up to you to save this party!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_07_SUMMERNIGHTS_10_IN: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:winnie}Alright, no more tricks, Zomboss. What are you up to this time?
{SAY:crazydave}Yeah, if you wanted to be at our party that bad, you could've just asked.
{SAY:winnie}User Dave. I am not entertaining the idea of inviting any zombie, regardless of status, to this party.
{SAY:zombossicon}I care not for your opinion of me! And for once, I'm not doing this for myself!
{TIRED:winnie}Given your previous selfish goals and motivations, I find that hard to believe.
{SAY:zombossicon}It's the truth!
{SAY:zombossicon}You may or may not remember my layabout sorry excuse of a nephew from my brilliant holiday plans!
{SAY:crazydave}The nephew that you indirectly killed by sending to an open warzone?
{SAY:zombossicon}Don't try to take the moral high ground here! YOUR plants were the ones that killed him!
{SAY:zombossicon}Regardless of that, I made sure to clone a new version of him to spare myself from my nagging mother's wrath!
{SAY:zombossicon}But it seems that the absurdity of my mother still eludes me.
{SAY:zombossicon}She asked me to throw him an "apology party" for getting him hurt in that battle!
{SAY:zombossicon}I am NOT throwing a party for that problem child! Not even for a clone of him!
{SAY:zombossicon}It's a matter of principles! That's why I've been sending his friends to your party instead!
{TIRED:winnie}You're using our party as your apology party instead of making your own?
{SAY:zombossicon}Yes, I know. How brilliant of me! I've forged all those invitations myself!
{EXCITED:crazydave}See, Penny? I didn't do it!
{SAY:zombossicon}Oh, and by the way. The Zombert clone is on his way for his party.
{SAY:zombossicon}So make sure to make him have a good time. Or don't. I can always clone another one if things go awry!
{SAY:zombossicon}He's your problem now! See you!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{TIRED:winnie}So now I'm stuck with two people trying to take advantage of all my hard work preparing this party.
{SAY:crazydave}Two people? Who's the other guy?
{TIRED:winnie}My programming dictates I should not answer. It is irrelevant.
{TIRED:winnie}Let's just take care of Zomboss's nephew and be done with this.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_1_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, may I inquire you about our current whereabouts?
{SAY:winnie}I certainly do not recollect traveling back to Egyptian times on my own accord.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I went out to a party last night, you know, with some frat guys-
{TIRED:winnie}No need to explain further, User Dave.
{TIRED:winnie}I'd take that you have somehow gotten into a situation with these, "frat zombies."
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I'd lost a bet! And they were going to take away my brains! I still need those.
{SAY:crazydave}So they said they were going to let me go if I help out with their final project!
{SAY:winnie}I'd take their final project for university involves something about breaching lawn defenses?
{SAY:crazydave}Something like that. You know those cuckoo researcher types!
{EXCITED:crazydave}They said they were conducting research about the efficiency of Vasebreaking!
{SAY:winnie}Which would explain the vases on the lawn. Understood.
{EXCITED:crazydave}Well, neighbor, you're a good Vasebreaker, aren't you? Mind lending a hand?
{TIRED:winnie}I'd say it's best for us to just to follow along for now.
{SAY:winnie}Be mindful of the vases you break, as usual.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_3_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I assume we have entered the second stage of research.
{SAY:crazydave}The guys told me that they're studying some stuff.
{SAY:crazydave}The effects of cold environments in enhancing zombie's powers.
{SAY:winnie}User Dave, is it wise to aid zombies in researching more efficient ways to defeat us?
{EXCITED:crazydave}Nonsense, Penny! We all know that piercing cold has no way of boosting zombies!
{SAY:crazydave}The poor guy doing this research is probably in for the revision of a lifetime!
{SAY:winnie}Perhaps so, but they have unintentionally created an unrelated phenomenon.
{EXCITED:winnie}Have you ever heard of the butterfly effect?
{EXCITED:winnie}Keep that in mind as we take part in this particular experiment.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_6_INTRO_: {EXCITED:crazydave}You need to keep your brain healthy and exercised to strengthen the flavor!
{TIRED:crazydave}Don't look at me like that! That's just what the zombies said.
{SAY:winnie}If that's the case, we have to make sure your brains are not on today's lunch special.
{SAY:winnie}These Gold Tiles will come in handy. Use them to your advantage.
{SAY:crazydave}I wonder what the brain exercise has to do with the tiles though...
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_8_INTRO_: {NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}Shouldn't this be one of your frat zombies' research?
{TIRED:crazydave}I don't think so. They didn't say anything about this!
{SAY:winnie}Zombie formations are way too structured to be the work of university student.
{SAY:winnie}There's a high likelihood of a more intellectual interference.
{SAY:winnie}Please pay close attention to the way these zombies attack.
{SAY:winnie}I daresay it'll give us a clue to who's really behind all this.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_10_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}I've been conducting my own research on the nature of the past recent "experiments."
{TIRED:winnie}It shouldn't come as a surprise at this point.
{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}I see that you cretins have taken an interest in higher education!
{SAY:zombossicon}Have my academic achievements become a point of envy for the below average-intellect?
{SAY:winnie}Do not flatter yourself, Zomboss. We are simply partaking as consultants for some of your zombies' research.
{SAY:zombossicon}Yes, you are! But I'm afraid there's a slight miscalculation in your thesis.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Not your zombies? But aren't you supposed to be the Boss Man?
{SAY:zombossicon}I am the Boss Man! But some times, some idiots think they've got what it takes to overthrow me.
{SAY:zombossicon}How preposterous! No zombie matches my superior intellect!
{SAY:zombossicon}Normally, I care not for their short-lived rebellious attempts, but this one in particular intrigues me.
{SAY:zombossicon}If I'm right about who's behind this- and I usually am, this has the potential to be most entertaining!
{SAY:winnie}Do you care to elaborate on that?
{SAY:zombossicon}Perhaps I'd tell you if you survive some of my own research!
{SAY:zombossicon}The advancements of the future are here, and with them comes Power Tiles!
{SAY:zombossicon}Check out this technology and let's see what you make of it!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_12_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, my investigations have shown something interesting.
{SAY:winnie}Not quite. But there seems to be a recent internal power struggle amongst the zombies.
{EXCITED:winnie}Some of the more "educated" zombies have grown unsatisfied with Zomboss' continuous failures.
{SAY:winnie}This lines up with what Dr. Zomboss had corroborated earlier.
{SAY:crazydave}Wait. You're saying that these frat zombies are... what?
{SAY:crazydave}Trying to take away Boss Man's Boss-manship?
{SAY:winnie}We can't say for sure, but there's high likelihood that they are.
{TIRED:crazydave}That'll explain why they haven't been around. I haven't seen them in days.
{PLAYFUL:winnie}That should be a good thing. But let's not worry about that for now.
{SAY:winnie}It seems Zomboss has thoughtfully left us a puzzle to preoccupy ourselves with in their place.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_08_BIGBRAINZ_13_INTRO: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}So, I was right! It really was those guys!
{SAY:crazydave}You seem really happy, Boss Man.
{SAY:zombossicon}I am! Oh, to see those losers I used to shove into lockers in college again!
{SAY:zombossicon}You know why they had paused their research earlier?
{SAY:zombossicon}They were trying to discredit my accolades and revoke my Thanatology degree!
{SAY:zombossicon}They can try their hardest! They'll never prove that I stole that thesis off someone else!
{SAY:winnie}Wait, what?
{SAY:zombossicon}And due to that pointless endeavor, they didn't have time to complete their research!
{SAY:zombossicon}Now they're gonna have to repeat their final year, for the tenth year in a row!
{SAY:zombossicon}HA-HA-HA!
{SAY:crazydave}Wow, Boss Man. What a bully!
{SAY:zombossicon}What a shame, cause I'm going to throw the biggest graduation party there is - all without them!
{SAY:zombossicon}And I'll send them all straight to your house! MWA-HA-HA! I'm so smart!
{NPC_EXIT:zombossicon}{SAY:winnie}Seems we solved that little mystery of where your frat friends went off to, User Dave.
{SAY:crazydave}Boss Man seems really happy to be rid of them.
{TIRED:winnie}I daresay this won't be the last we see of them.
{SAY:winnie}It seems like they really have it in for Dr. Zomboss. And they're probably not going to stop here.
{SAY:winnie}Dr. Zomboss might not acknowledge them as a threat for now, but his hubris has always been his greatest weakness.
{SAY:winnie}But we can save that talk for later. We have a rampaging horde of fresh graduates marching to our location.
{SAY:crazydave}Really? Cause I don't see them.
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}Maybe they just find the entry qualifications for our lawn too complex!
{PLAYFUL:crazydave}I can relate. I've never been good with Beghouled!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:crazydave}Penny, I have something urgent to tell you.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_2: {TIRED:winnie}Is this about your attempt on creating a manure-powered field tiller?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_3: {SAY:crazydave}No, Penny! I'm not playing around this time!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_6: {TIRED:crazydave}That's on me. I've been going through our Winter Melon reserves.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_7: {TIRED:crazydave}That's why they've been a bit weaker. The high quality seeds have gone out at this point.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}I see. You need not blame yourself, User Dave. This was partially my fault.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_9: {TIRED:winnie}I wasn't keeping track of our inventory.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_10: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}I think we should go ahead and resupply! And what better time to do that than now?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_11: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}It's the month of Harvest! Where plants bloom and the doom glooms.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}You are correct, User Dave. But data reserves show a certain obstacle regarding that.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_14: {SAY:winnie}Well, that- but mainly the fact that some of our plants only grow in certain climates.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_15: {SAY:winnie}We might need to travel the world - and in some cases through time - to refresh our stocks.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_16: {EXCITED:crazydave}Then it's time for a road trip! Just two people and a talking RV passing the countryside!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_17: {SAY:winnie}Yes, a trip is needed. But first, we need to clear these zombies out of the driveway.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_1_INTRO_18: {EXCITED:crazydave}We're not taking stowaways! Let's handle them, neighbor!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{EXCITED:winnie}User Dave, I've managed to gather a selection of seeds on our first trip.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Oooh! That's wonderful, Penny. We can start growing these in no time!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_3: {EXCITED:winnie}Correct. Your neighbor's front lawn has everything that a growing plant needs.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}But perfect humidity and moisture can only go so far in aiding our plant's growth-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_6: {SAY:crazydave}I don't need pesticides! Stinky the Snail only eats chocolates!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I am not talking about the gastropod, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}The pests in need of taking care of are zombies.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}These plants need time to grow. Make sure the zombies don't disrupt our crops while they bloom.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_3_INTRO_11: {PLAYFUL:crazydave}Yeah. Walking in on a plant that's blooming is just bad manners!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}The logs show that our primal plant reserves are in short supply.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}Which is to be expected. Without our accidental interference, they're supposedly already extinct.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}We can't have them extinct! They're so useful!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}While the sentiment applies to our exotic friends, other things from this period are meant to expire.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}I'm detecting unusual zombie activity in the area, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}They're aided, as usual, by the wildlife exclusive to this time period.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_4_INTRO_10: {SAY:winnie}That's right. We need to be vigilant. Zombies and dinosaurs are never a good combination.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}User Dave, I'm detecting unusual activity of wildlife.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_2: {SAY:crazydave}Isn't that to be expected? We're in the Wild West!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_3: {TIRED:winnie}To a certain extent, yes. However, my readings show numbers that exceed normal expectations.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_4: {TIRED:winnie}We're looking at a 85% increase in likelihood of cattle stampedes.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_5: {SAY:crazydave}Oh, that's 85% too many for my liking.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. Most curious is that the zombies seem to have a hand in these botched odds.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_6_INTRO_7: {SAY:winnie}With their previous behavior riling up dinosaurs in the marsh, I have to wonder-
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{SAY:winnie}There's no mistaking it now, User Dave.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_2: {SAY:winnie}It seems that we're not the only ones cultivating troops.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_3: {SAY:winnie}The zombies seem to have taken an interest in expanding their roster of menageries.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_4: {SAY:crazydave}Why, though? Are they also going through a shortage?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_5: {SAY:winnie}Possibly. But it's all speculation at this point.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_6: {SAY:winnie}Judging by patterns of behavior, Zomboss will certainly appear near the end of the month.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_7: {EXCITED:crazydave} And that's when he'll spill the beans!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_8: {SAY:winnie}Indeed. The only thing we can do in the meantime is to round up all his herded beasts.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_9: {SAY:winnie}I suppose our collected selection of plants would be able to handle such a task.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_10: {SAY:crazydave}Penny, we haven't gone through restocking all of our seed supplies yet!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_11: {TIRED:crazydave}I can't let you use certain seeds. Some of them only have a single packet left!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_12: {SAY:winnie}That is fine, User Dave. Your neighbor has proven to be very resourceful.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_7_INTRO_13: {EXCITED:winnie}I'm sure they'll manage to get through this, even with the imposed restrictions.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_1: {NPC_ENTER:crazydave}{NPC_ENTER:winnie}{NPC_ENTER:zombossicon}{SAY:zombossicon}Hello, hello? Is this blasted thing on?!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_2: {EXCITED:crazydave}Boss Man! Are you outside? I can hear mooing and hissing from your end.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_3: {SAY:zombossicon}What?! Speak up! I can't hear you! It's an entire jungle in here!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_4: {SAY:winnie}Is there any reason for this transmission, Zomboss?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_5: {SAY:zombossicon}Is that the machine speaking? Yes, I- no, you rotten critter, let go!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_6: {TIRED:winnie}Even for your standards, that was rather crude.
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_8: {SAY:zombossicon}I wasn't- talking to you- AGH! Finally!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_9: {SAY:zombossicon}This is all your fault! You must be behind this!
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_11: {SAY:zombossicon}Do not play dumb! Who else would stuff an entire zoo inside my lab?
NARRATIVE_LTE_2024_09_HARVEST_9_INTRO_12: {SAY:zombossicon}My operating table smells like manure and there's weasels in my unwashed boxers!

UNUSED_43_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}阻止绅士僵尸起飞

{FLAVOR}有些乡巴佬总把吹风荚兰和鼓风机混为一谈.还有人怀疑它是僵尸,因为它有着严重的口臭,无论如何都除不掉.吹风荚兰并不擅长给人留下好的初印象.
UNUSED_43_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 吹风荚兰能发射具有眩晕效果的风,且越到一行的末端威力越强.
UNUSED_45_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}毒药可以毒缓僵尸并具有穿甲效果

{FLAVOR}芦藜药师从老约瑟胡夫那里学到了古老的制药术,在那里它也习得了如何调配完美毒药.据芦藜药师回忆,老约瑟胡夫也居住在下水道里,频繁地和那些巨型地精领主战斗.真是了不起的老头子.
UNUSED_45_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 芦藜药师能投掷花苞,并有概率扔出穿甲且具有毒缓效果的毒药.
UNUSED_45_TOOLTIP: 投掷花苞和具有穿甲伤害的毒药
UNUSED_47_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}可以种在水上

{FLAVOR}猫尾草在社交媒体上非常活跃,尤其是在树叶论坛上.它以'像猫一样的生物,但实际上不是猫'的独立形象而闻名,并经常对各种猫粮发表有争议的观点.
UNUSED_47_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 猫尾草能够在靠近它的僵尸身上发射追踪它们的尖刺.
UNUSED_46_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}射出去的水泡很短时间后就会破裂

{FLAVOR}莲藕射手奉行资深环保主义.每当它看到天空中弥漫着烟雾,就会瞬间暴怒,它此时必须好好发泄一番.无论是植物还是僵尸,请在它发怒的时候躲远点!
UNUSED_46_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 莲藕射手对本行僵尸连发大量水泡,弹体散射,距离越近伤害越高.
UNUSED_49_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}向前抛出一个弹跳齿轮,同时向后抛出一个大齿轮,大齿轮会向前回弹,造成高额伤害
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}喂食叶绿素后将永久提升它的齿轮伤害

{FLAVOR}番莲工程师一直抱怨不得不在这么危险的环境里干活.它实在受不了工厂附近弥漫的蒸汽,烟雾,还有那些臭烘烘的僵尸胡子.罢工也毫无用处,毕竟僵尸们本来就不乐意有株植物在这儿干它们该干的脏活累活.
UNUSED_49_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 番莲工程师向前发射弹跳小齿轮,向后发射最终会转向的大齿轮.
UNUSED_48_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}优先打击巫师僵尸
{KEYWORD}弱点: {STAT}无法让高生命值僵尸和巨人僵尸变成引力球体

{FLAVOR}经过长期研究,扇贝兰法师终于找到了穿越多元宇宙的方法.不过,它把本不该出现在这个时空的僵尸物种带了过来.仿佛普通僵尸在这儿有多受欢迎似的.
UNUSED_48_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 扇贝兰法师使用它们的黑暗法术把僵尸变成能够吸引其他僵尸的引力球体.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}无法被僵尸啃食
{KEYWORD}弱点: {STAT}能被滚动物体击败

{FLAVOR}熔岩地刺在幼苗时期就潜心修习武术,在西藏寒冷的高山之巅耗费数十年打磨技艺.任何使用火焰让对手手忙脚乱,应接不暇的招式,它全都烂熟于心.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 熔岩地刺炙烤走在它身上的僵尸,与其他的地刺类植物不同,飞行类僵尸它也能攻击到.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_PLANTFOOD: Scorches two tiles to the left and right of himself, dealing massive damage.
HOLLYBARRIERLEAF_TOOLTIP: 将走在它身上的僵尸烧成灰烬
PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}温暖内部的植物
{KEYWORD}弱点: {STAT}仍然会被冰冻

{FLAVOR}烈焰藤蔓考虑着它的股票,它的巨款,它聚藏的大量财富.它觉得这些应该能让它高兴起来,尽管如此,它还是忧虑着.
PYREVINE_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 烈焰藤蔓可以种在其他植物上为它们额外添加近距离火焰攻击.
PYREVINE_PLANTFOOD: Throws a line of flame down five tiles, damaging all zombies in it.
PYREVINE_TOOLTIP: 制造短距离火焰,温暖内部的植物
POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}范围: {STAT}接触

{FLAVOR}脆薯片总说,随遇而安很重要.袋装,筒装,或是别的什么包装,都是生活嘛.它常说要大步向前,保持微笑.可脆薯片压根不知道'咔嚓'这个可怕的概念是什么意思!
POTATOCHIP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 脆薯片在接触时会爆炸,在小范围对僵尸造成轻度伤害.
POTATOCHIP_TOOLTIP: 接触时爆炸,造成轻度伤害
CARAMELPOPCORN_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}伤害细节: {STAT}轻微(焦糖玉米粒),中等(爆米花)
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}焦糖玉米粒能造成溅射伤害并减速僵尸
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}爆米花能在一片区域造成溅射伤害并减速僵尸

{FLAVOR}"我和玉米投手?我们关系好着呢," 它说道. "我扔焦糖,它扔黄油,但我们要的效果一样,目标也一致.我受够了有些人总爱编造矛盾,谁说甜的和咸的就不能凑一块儿了?"
CARAMELPOPCORN_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 焦糖爆米花投手向僵尸投掷可减速的焦糖玉米粒和爆米花.
CARAMELPOPCORN_TOOLTIP: 向僵尸投掷可减速的焦糖玉米粒和爆米花
LOTUSPOD_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}由种植位置决定攻击方式
{KEYWORD}特殊: {STAT}鱼雷能造成小范围伤害

{FLAVOR}莲小蓬来自一片遥远的异域之地,本想向全世界展示它精湛的两栖本领.结果到头来,它能找到的活儿全都是跟水有关的.五年苦练的拔根脱身绝技,算是彻底白费了...
LOTUSPOD_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: 莲小蓬在陆地上投掷种子,在水里则向前发射鱼雷.
LOTUSPOD_TOOLTIP: 在陆地上投掷种子,在水里则向前发射鱼雷
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (monitor) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}Knows next to nothing about computers, other than the fact that they make very good headwear.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: A typical ZCorp employee, except with better computer skills.
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}2200 (monitor) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.2

{FLAVOR}Once a member of ZCorp's IT department, Computerhead Contractor was demoted back to contractor after one-too-many lawsuits relating to her slamming computers onto Dr. Zomboss' head under the guise of "tech support."
ZOMBIE_ZCORP_FEM_ARMOR4_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: Her computer skills, more specifically her ability to have an entire computer on her head, really gives this contractor the biggest edge.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Zombie just doesn't feel like he's getting anywhere with this whole "love" thing. They say you gotta open up your heart to succeed. He just wants to open the mind. Don't get the wrong impression: he's not much of an intellectual. He's just hungry.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Conehead uses his cone for protection against flying peas, lasers, and watermelons, but also as protection against heartbreak. The cone is always there for him.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His cone hat makes him twice as irresistible - and also twice as tough.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Buckethead was in need of a prom date. He saw a bucket in the street and it was love at first sight. It’s kind of sad. Don’t pick prom dates off the street, kids.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEA: His stylish bucket attracts dates and resists projectile damage.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Valenbrainz Flag Zombie carries the balloons for a reason. He just likes to let his thoughts float away in hope that one day he will find love. You’d expect him to let the balloons float away after he does this, but he holds onto them, like the wallet he put in his ripped pocket.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Marks the arrival of a huge lovesick "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with heart pole
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}launches Cupid Imp when damaged

{FLAVOR}This Gargantuar believes that he's been blessed with a cupid's arrow. In reality, he's just way into Valenbrainz.
Enormous lovebug who crushes in more ways than one.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_IMP_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}First place winner of every cupid contest since 2015.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_IMP_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Floats over most of your defenses, then flutters onward.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_JANE_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}350
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.25
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}She finds it strikingly weird that she happened to be the only female zombie willing to associate herself with Valenbrainz, but she doesn't complain about it too much. All the constant attention she's been getting all but makes up for it.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_JANE_DESCRIPTION_HEADE: Parasol provides great rejection for lobbed projectiles and too-forward confessions.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}650 (balloon) + 250
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.4
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Love is in the air? Wrong. That is a zombie and you've fallen for his trap.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_BALLOON_DESCRIPTION_HE: Valenbrainz zombie with a balloon. Zombie will float above plants until balloon is popped.
ZOMBIE_VALENTINES_SUPERFANIMP_DESCRIPTIO:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}270
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.22
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to Stallia effects

{FLAVOR}Being a fan of both Cupid and Stupid takes a toll on this zombie. Luckily, his explosive attitude more than makes up for it.
Blows up plants with his loving attitude.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}St. Paddy's Zombie thought he was the luckiest zombie alive, then he got drafted to Holiday Mashup.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}370 (cone) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}Constantly complains how he was fed lies about there being tons of gold at the end of a rainbow. All he found were cones. Maybe one day he'll notice that he went to the wrong end.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR1_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His lucky cone gives him double the health of a normal St. Paddy’s zombie.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}1100 (bucket) + 190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}Clearly remembers seeing a four-leafed clover somewhere.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_ARMOR2_DESCRIPTION_HEAD: His bucket is so lucky that it even resists projectile damage.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}190
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.185
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects

{FLAVOR}He traded in a four-leafed clover for this lucky, one of a kind flag, said to give you all the luck in the world. So far all it did was make his arm tired.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_FLAG_DESCRIPTION_HEADER: Marks the arrival of a huge Irish-dancing "wave" of zombies.
ZOMBIE_STPATRICK_GARGANTUAR_DESCRIPTION:
{KEYWORD}Health: {STAT}3600
{KEYWORD}Speed: {STAT}0.24
{KEYWORD}Holiday Spirit: {STAT}75% resistant to stun effects
{KEYWORD}Damage: {STAT}crushes plants with magical guitar
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}throws Leprechaun Imp when damaged
{KEYWORD}Special: {STAT}bashes out sonic blasts at range, damaging plants
